results.name: the app starts with a tray, an open window and a running execution host
a real task is in flight on that host, waiting on a decision
closing the window leaves the execution host running, and the tray says so
the work is left exactly as it was, waiting on a person rather than on a window
the tray entry reopens the window, and produces no duplicate runtime
quitting with nothing running still says what teammates will see
quitting while work is running warns, names it, and defaults to not quitting
an explicit quit shuts the managed processes down
a launch restores where to connect, who this is and how the window sat
a fresh launch restores the task without resuming it
the tray icon itself was not clicked
results.detail: no supported platform lets a test make the OS open a tray menu; the entries in the menu the app installed are invoked by their own handlers, so what is untested is the click that opens it

results.name: the quit dialog was not clicked either
results.detail: a native modal cannot be answered by a test in this harness; its text, buttons and default are asserted from the plan it is built from, and the answer is chosen for it
